```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
```

Score filtering and a gene-level case/control burden test to find candidate
NON-ESTABLISHED genes. Needs the tables written by `02_read_filter_save.Rmd`
(PAPSS2/FAM20C removal and re-ranking already happened there).

## Settings

```{r settings}
max_rank         <- candidate_max_rank  # set in 00_setup.R
or_cutoff       <- 0.25  # minimum gene-level burden OR
max_carrier_frac <- 0.01  # at most 1% carriers in cases and in controls
n_cases_total    <- 701   # fixed cohort sizes, not derived from the data
n_controls_total <- 200
control_pattern  <- "^G"  # control Participant_IDs start with "G"
benign_classes   <- c("LIKELY_BENIGN", "BENIGN")
```

## Data

```{r data}
all_vars <- read_all_vars() %>%
  mutate(VAR = str_split_i(HGVS, ":", 3),
         UNIQUE_ID = paste0(HGVS, "_", Participant_ID))

write_tsv(all_vars, all_vars_file)
```

## Score filtering

```{r score-filter}
top_vars <- all_vars %>%
  filter(EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE > var_score_cutoff,
         EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE > pheno_score_cutoff_candidate,
         RANK <= max_rank)

new_genes <- top_vars %>% filter(GROUP == "NON-ESTABLISHED")

message("Top-ranked NON-ESTABLISHED rows: ", nrow(new_genes),
        " in ", n_distinct(new_genes$GENE_SYMBOL), " genes")
```

## Per-gene carrier counts and burden test

```{r burden}
gene_burden <- new_genes %>%
  group_by(GENE_SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(
    N_All      = n_distinct(Participant_ID),
    N_Controls = n_distinct(Participant_ID[str_detect(Participant_ID, control_pattern)]),
    N_Cases    = N_All - N_Controls,
    MEAN_VARIANT_SCORE = mean(EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE),
    MEAN_PHENO_SCORE   = mean(EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Fisher's exact test per gene: carriers vs total cohort size, cases vs controls
fisher_burden <- function(n_cases, n_controls) {
  test <- fisher.test(matrix(c(n_cases,    n_cases_total,
                               n_controls, n_controls_total),
                             nrow = 2))
  tibble(OR = unname(test$estimate), p_val = test$p.value)
}

gene_burden <- gene_burden %>%
  mutate(fisher = map2(N_Cases, N_Controls, fisher_burden)) %>%
  unnest(fisher)
```

Genes with more than 90 carriers:

```{r frequent-genes}
gene_burden %>% filter(N_All > 90) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Candidate filters

```{r candidates}
# Genes also found at top rank in ESTABLISHED cases are assumed false positives
established_top_genes <- top_vars %>%
  filter(GROUP == "ESTABLISHED") %>%
  pull(GENE_SYMBOL)

# Genes with at least one top-ranked variant not classified (likely) benign
not_benign_genes <- new_genes %>%
  filter(!EXOMISER_ACMG_CLASSIFICATION %in% benign_classes) %>%
  pull(GENE_SYMBOL)

candidates <- gene_burden %>%
  filter(
    OR > or_cutoff,
    N_Cases > 1,
    N_Cases    <= floor(max_carrier_frac * n_cases_total),
    N_Controls <= floor(max_carrier_frac * n_controls_total),
    !GENE_SYMBOL %in% established_top_genes,
    GENE_SYMBOL %in% not_benign_genes,
    GENE_SYMBOL != "NHERF1"  # synonym of an ESTABLISHED gene (SLC9A3R1)
  )

candidate_vars <- new_genes %>%
  filter(!EXOMISER_ACMG_CLASSIFICATION %in% benign_classes,
         GENE_SYMBOL %in% candidates$GENE_SYMBOL)

message("Candidate NON-ESTABLISHED genes: ", nrow(candidates))
knitr::kable(candidates, digits = 3)
```

## Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(candidates,     candidates_file)
write_tsv(candidate_vars, candidate_vars_file)
```
